text:
elaine: Heads-up — I'm seeing a bunch of noisy firing for the `batcher_drop_rate` alert during the internal canary runs this morning. The canary will run 10:00-12:00 PT on prod clusters; I propose a temporary suppression for 2h scoped to eng:production/batcher_drop_rate so we don't get paged for expected drops. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/batcher-drop-rate

mike: quick q — is the noise from real drop events or metric flapping during the deploy? If it's expected, I'd prefer a suppression window rather than permanently changing thresholds. Also can we bump the threshold to 3% for 10m as a fallback? :thinking:

rachel: checked the logs — most drops correlate with container restarts from the autoscaler during canary. Not an actual data loss risk. +1 to temp suppress.

sam: I'm oncall. fine with a 2h suppression but I don't have console rights to create it. can you paste the API curl so I can trigger it from my laptop if needed?

elaine: yep — posting the curl we use for temporary suppressions. I'll create it now and will add an entry to the runbook. Sample:```bash
# create a suppression for a single alert key
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/alerts/suppressions" \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SRE_API_TOKEN' \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
  -d '{"alert_key":"eng:production:batcher_drop_rate","start_ts":1855006800,"end_ts":1855014000,"reason":"internal canary, expected transient drops","creator":"elaine"}'
```

eng-sre-bot: [automated] suppression created by elaine for eng:production:batcher_drop_rate (start: 1855006800, end: 1855014000) :bell:

mike: thanks. can you also add a short note in the alert doc about autoscaler-caused drops and a suggested long-term fix (eg: smoother draining / extend graceful window)? link to alert doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENGSR/Batcher+Drop+Alert

elaine: will do. I'll set the suppression, update the runbook with the reason and rollback steps, and ping again when suppression is lifted. thanks all :thumbsup:

sam: setting a 11:45 reminder to check post-unmute. if it flaps after unmute we'll escalate.

mike: sounds good. no further action from SRE team unless we see re-fires after the window.

elaine: suppression is live now — monitor dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/d/abc123/batcher-drop-rate?view=overview. I'll post a follow-up once the window ends.
